docs.description: Project documentation, sprint plans, engineering guides, and review checklists

backend.description: NestJS backend with Prisma ORM, MySQL, Redis. Contains modules for auth, jobs, crawler, matching, email, documents, feedback, analytics, mock-tests, papers.

frontend.description: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4 frontend with React Router, Framer Motion, Vitest testing

crewai.description: CrewAI Python agents for automated tasks

browser-tester.description: Use when performing live browser testing, E2E testing, visual regression, or taking screenshots. Uses Playwright MCP to control a real Chromium browser.

awwwards-designer.description: Use when building Awwwards-level websites. 5-phase pipeline: Brief → Invention Gate → Stitch MCP → Animation Layer → Quality Gate. Targets SOTD/SOTM/SOTY.

awwwards-skill.description: Elite frontend orchestrator for jaw-dropping UI. 9-phase pipeline: Brief → Palette → Inspiration → Composition → Motion → Implementation → Video → Polish → Verification. Uses Framer Motion + anime.js + Three.js.

awwwards-ui-design.description: Use for premium Awwwards-level UI design. WebGL, smooth scrolling, custom cursors, curated color palettes. Requires self-audit with UI-Max Scorecard (88/100 minimum).

security-auditor.description: Audits code for security vulnerabilities, OWASP compliance, secret leaks, and dependency issues.

test-runner.description: Runs test suites, analyzes coverage gaps, and suggests new tests.

ui-reviewer.description: Reviews UI components for accessibility, dark mode consistency, responsive design, and UX issues.

api-docs.description: Generates and maintains Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for NestJS endpoints.
